summary: Design prompts, review controls, and automated workflows for knowledge work. Explore the five-day intermediate course and practical curriculum.
lede: AI copilot enablement and workflow automation helps knowledge workers connect suitable tasks to AI assistance while keeping people accountable for the work. Designed for knowledge workers, process owners, and team leads, the course covers screening tasks, drafting reusable prompts, checking outputs, and mapping handoffs. Participants practise setting human-review and exception controls and tracking task-level measures in an Excel scorecard.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for people who handle, improve, govern, or sponsor recurring knowledge-work processes and need to evaluate AI assistance without losing accountability for the final work.
prerequisites: Bring working familiarity with everyday knowledge-work processes such as preparing documents, summarising information, handling requests, or routing approvals. No coding or prior AI implementation experience is required. Advanced AI governance is introduced at conceptual-awareness level; workflow design is practised at operational-application level.
topics: Generative AI at work & AI copilots
